description: Policy enforcement engine: access control, rate limiting, circuit breaking with dual-end caching

requirements.title: Access control rules
requirements.description: Rules define which source scenarios can call which target scenarios with effect and priority.

requirements.title: Priority-based rule matching
requirements.description: Rules evaluated in priority order; highest priority matching rule determines outcome

requirements.title: Conflict resolution with equal priority
requirements.description: When multiple rules match at equal priority, deny takes precedence over allow

requirements.title: Default allow policy
requirements.description: When no rules match, default policy is allow-all (configurable to deny)

requirements.title: Rate limiting rules
requirements.description: Rules define request rate caps per scenario pair with sliding window.

requirements.title: Circuit breaker rules
requirements.description: Per-scenario-pair circuit breaker with three states: closed, open, half-open.

requirements.title: Three-state circuit breaker
requirements.description: Circuit breaker tracks closed, open, and half-open states with configurable thresholds

requirements.title: State transition persistence
requirements.description: Circuit breaker state transitions persisted and replaceable via override

requirements.title: Circuit breaker configuration
requirements.description: Configurable failure_threshold, window_seconds, cooldown_seconds, and success_threshold

requirements.title: Policy CRUD API
requirements.description: REST endpoints for policy rule management with validation.

requirements.title: SSE policy push channel
requirements.description: Dedicated SSE endpoint pushing PolicyUpdate events when rules change.

requirements.title: Policy evaluation engine
requirements.description: Evaluation order: circuit breaker → access control → rate limiting.

requirements.title: Access control evaluation phase
requirements.description: Evaluator matches rules by source/target/endpoint globs with priority-based resolution

requirements.title: Endpoint pattern glob matching
requirements.description: Policy evaluator supports glob patterns for endpoint matching

requirements.title: Structured PolicyDecision response
requirements.description: Returns structured response with allowed, rule_id, rule_type, reason, retry_after, circuit_state

requirements.title: Policy violation logging
requirements.description: Denied requests logged as policy_violations records, queryable with filters.

requirements.title: Circuit breaker manual override
requirements.description: POST /api/v1/policies/:id/override to force circuit breaker state.

requirements.title: Deny-wins tie-breaking rule
requirements.description: When multiple rules match at equal priority, deny effect takes precedence

requirements.title: Default mode configuration
requirements.description: Default policy configurable between allow-all and deny-all via settings

requirements.title: Rate limit rule storage
requirements.description: Rate limit rules stored with max_requests, window_seconds, and scenario pair

requirements.title: Sliding window implementation
requirements.description: Window slides based on request timestamps, not fixed intervals

requirements.title: Rate check evaluation
requirements.description: Counts requests within sliding window and compares against threshold

requirements.title: Override event broadcasting
requirements.description: Circuit breaker state changes broadcast to SSE policy subscribers

requirements.title: Threshold value validation
requirements.description: Validates failure_threshold > 0, window_seconds > 0, cooldown_seconds > 0

requirements.title: CRUD endpoint handlers
requirements.description: POST create, GET list/get, PUT update, DELETE remove with proper status codes

requirements.title: Rule validation on create/update
requirements.description: Validates required fields, rule type, and scenario glob patterns

requirements.title: Schema enforcement
requirements.description: Request bodies validated against rule type schema before persistence

requirements.title: Policy change event generation
requirements.description: Generates PolicyUpdate event on rule create, update, delete operations

requirements.title: Update event payload format
requirements.description: Event includes action (created/updated/deleted), rule_id, and full rule snapshot

requirements.title: SSE policy subscriber delivery
requirements.description: Delivers policy update events to all connected SSE policy subscribers

requirements.title: Multi-field glob matching
requirements.description: Evaluator matches source, target, and endpoint fields with independent glob patterns

requirements.title: Retry-after calculation for rate limits
requirements.description: PolicyDecision includes retry_after seconds when rate limit exceeded

requirements.title: Violation record creation
requirements.description: Creates violation record with source, target, rule_id, rule_type, timestamp, reason

requirements.title: Time-range query support
requirements.description: Violations queryable by start/end timestamp range

requirements.title: Violation query with filters
requirements.description: List violations filtered by source, target, rule_id with pagination

requirements.title: Override request validation
requirements.description: Validates target state (open/closed/half-open) and circuit breaker exists

requirements.title: Override audit trail
requirements.description: Override actions logged with timestamp and previous state for auditing

requirements.title: State persistence on override
requirements.description: Overridden state persisted to database and broadcast via SSE
